dcterms:description: A small-scale dataset I2AwA, which is a replacement of the original AwA dataset for zero-shot learning. It consists of 50 animal classes, with a total of 37,322 images and an average of 746 images per class. The dataset is split into 40 known categories and 10 unknown categories.
dcterms:title: I2AwA

dcterms:description: A large-scale dataset I2WebV, where the source domain is ILSVRC-2012 with 1,000 classes consisting of 1,279,847 images. The target domain is the validation set of WebVision with 5,000 classes, composed of 294,009 images. This dataset presents a significant challenge due to the large domain discrepancy and the presence of many unknown categories.
dcterms:title: I2WebV
